thread:
Jin: We need to tighten who can request SIEM exports for vuln triage. Proposal: introduce scoped roles + a short-lived approval token. Questions on RBAC naming and audit fields.
Rashid: Scoped role names: siem:request_export, siem:approve_export, siem:emergency_unseal. Add constraint `requires_ticket` for requesters.
Marta: Audit schema: include `requester`, `approvers`, `dataset`, `fields_requested`, `pii_present`, `ticket_id`, `ttl_seconds`, `decryption_events`. Keep logs immutable and forward to our analytics cluster.
Ava: For KMS, use envelope encryption with CMK in KMS; don't allow CMK:Decrypt to humans. Approver service gets decrypt rights via short-lived service tokens.
Jin: Emergency flow: allow SRE+SOC single-step for oncall, but require mandatory post-incident review and tag `emergency:true`.
Rashid: Policy snippet idea:
```hcl
allow "siem:approve_export" {
  principals = ["role:secops_lead","role:sre_lead"]
  constraints = { "mfa": true }
}
```
Marta: Also propose retention rules: forwarder views stored 90d, sealed snapshots 30d default, legal hold overrides to 365+; purge job to run daily.
sec-bot: Created task SIEM-4040 assigned to Rashid + Jin for RBAC naming and audit schema.
Jin: I'll draft RFC with sample logs and event flow.
Rashid: Let's also add alerts if same requester generates >5 sealed snapshots in 7 days. Possible abuse signal.
Marta: Good call. I'll add that to monitoring.
Ava: I'll coordinate with eng-infra on the DEK generation flow.
Jin: Thanks, will ping when RFC is ready for review.
